async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the project details page using the knowledge base function
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, 'Byte Blaze / a11y-syntax-highlighting')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 2: Click on the Issues link to go to the issues page
    # Assuming the Issues link is available with role 'link' and name 'Issues'
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Click the New issue button
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='New issue').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 4: Fill in the issue title and description
    title_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title')
    await title_input.fill('Connection refused in ChatGPT')
    
    desc_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await desc_input.fill('Issue: Connection refused when trying to access ChatGPT.')
    
    # Step 5: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # No further actions needed, so we can terminate
    return
